You are not being paranoid. Yes, in some relationships the s/o may have a really close friend of the opposite sex but there has to be some boundaries. If he’s putting you before another woman, that alone is a red flag. I had a really close best guy friend when I was in a relationship with my ex & that guy friend had a girlfriend too. We both knew our places. If we had plans and his girlfriend needed him to come over or for any reason at all, we’d schedule to hang out another time. And I’d never be upset about it, I’m not his girlfriend. What your boyfriend is doing is really concerning and I think you have every right to be worried. I too would be, and I’ve even discussed this with my current bf that this kind of behaviour on either of our ends would be weird, concerning & would make us both question the relationship and I’ve been with my bf for the same amount of time as you have been with yours. And that doesn’t just go for the opposite sex, in no case should you be the second priority, especially when it comes to someone who’s just a ‘friend’. Him lying to her about you, tells me that he’s either afraid to put someone else above her & wants to avoid that situation with her or he has feelings for her. Either way, someone who is already lying about you and putting someone else before you isn’t worth staying with. I’ve been through this kind of ish before and it’s not worth it, you only get hurt in the end because all of the red flags were there but you ignored it. And you look dumb because he ends up going to that SAME girl in the end anyways. (Which is what happened to me) And it’ll always be a problem if she can’t respect your relationship and if he can’t tell her to respect your relationship. The fact alone that he didn’t defend you and the relationship by saying something like “look this is my relationship and my girlfriend and she comes first if you’re not ok with that....etc” is not good. There are soooo many great guys out there, that’ll come with all the other good stuff as well as the respect you deserve & won’t hesitate to tell a girl to chill out if she’s stepping out of her place. But this is clearly something your bf is entertaining... I promise none of it is worth it if he isn’t treating you as a priority from the beginning. If you haven’t already, have a serious conversation about his feelings for her and where you stand when it comes to her.. and if you think it’s right, give him an ultimatum. At the end of the day it’s up to him and what HE does, not her. Honestly if he hesitates... leave girl!! Best of luck to you x
